baseline_reader: Already-shipped exact decoded-string reuse implementation; not the earlier ReadToEnd allocation baseline.
scope: Pool the private 4096-byte read-ahead block while retaining exact file reads, unchanged StreamReader UTF/BOM/decoder behavior and shipped decoded-text equality/reference reuse. This packet measures standalone managed allocation and GC counts, not compilation latency.
fixture: Synthetic valid ASCII C# files: 1,000 × 256 bytes; 1,000 × 4,096 bytes; 100 × 262,144 bytes. Each selected file changes one literal near its beginning on every pass. 100% means all files edited, not full-content replacement. BOM and malformed Unicode cases belong to quality checks, not allocation profiles.
latency_claim: All elapsed fields in every linked artifact are permanently unaccepted. No compile-time, time-to-play, native/Unity/Unreal comparison, peak RSS or speedup claim.

configuration.process_arm_order: Alternating arm order across nine configurations; one process per arm/configuration. No reversed pair per configuration, retries or extra cells.
configuration.counter: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(precise:true), whole process; corpus creation/producer edits/explicit GC/full ordinal validation/JSON output excluded from read allocation windows.
configuration.checksum_formula: Unchecked sum, over all returned sources, of UTF16 length plus first and last code units. Every UTF16 unit is also independently compared ordinally with the producer expected text outside the allocation window.

validation.observed_gc: Raw Gen0/1/2 counts are recorded for all five passes. No standalone GC-count or latency guarantee is inferred from these short runs.

integration_full_suite.configuration: xUnit.MaxParallelThreads=2; original test timeouts and production/internal concurrency unchanged
integration_full_suite.diagnostic_proof: xUnit log confirms parallel test collections = on [2 threads]

earlier_default_parallel_run.limits: Foreign Android emulator observed around1100%CPU. All3 failures passed isolated without source/timeout changes; this does not isolate scheduling from load.

real_clr_checks.shutdown_exception_found: Closed local pipe in worker finalization produced ObjectDisposedException on helper shutdown; tracked for separate fix before handover.

final_after_shutdown_fix.scheduling_limits: Two test collections, original deadlines and internal concurrent requests retained. This is quality validation, not timing acceptance.

covered_cases: Initial empty file, file addition/removal and restored same mtime
UTF8/16/32 BOM and invalid decoder units, CRLF and surrogates
FileShare.ReadWrite|Delete, open-handle replacement and 200 ms IO retry
4 KiB underlying read requests for 1 KiB reader calls, including oversized pool bucket
Large-read and nonseekable bypass, short reads, cross-block remainder, zero read and EOF
Char/byte pool exception return, rent failure, inner dispose failure, pool return failure and idempotence
Raw FileStream outer-scope ownership after constructor failure
quality.emit_requirements: Each of three valid-source comparisons requires Success=true, nonempty PE and exact complete PE/PDB byte equality, identical assembly/path and ModuleCompiler parse options (LanguageVersion.Latest, DocumentationMode.Parse, UTF8). Actual copied product compiler is Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp 5.3.0.0 because of product VersionOverride; no SDK compiler substitution.

initial_build_failure.cause: CA2022 in three deliberately throwing Read fixtures with ignored return counts. Mechanical correction includes any unexpected returned count in the failure message; no analyzer suppression.

fragmented_oracle_failure.cause: Fixture incorrectly required original Unicode text after every fragmented UTF16/32 BOM read. Unchanged StreamReader itself does not guarantee this when initial fragments are too small for encoding detection.

preserved_failures_and_fixture_diagnosis.corrected_quality_oracle: For each fragmented input, a fresh independent ProbeStream with the same cap feeds unchanged StreamReader.ReadToEnd. Its exact decoded string is the candidate prior; require full ordinal/hash equality, exact prior-reference reuse and equal detected encoding. Record original-text equality for both arms. Do not require a fixed baseline-defect count across runtime versions.

runtime_implementation_finding.private_file_buffer: BufferedFileStreamStrategy.EnsureBufferAllocated uses GC.AllocateUninitializedArray<byte>(_bufferSize); default FileStream buffer4096. FileStreamHelpers disables this strategy at bufferSize<=1.
runtime_implementation_finding.unchanged_reader: Default StreamReader keeps a 1,024-byte input buffer, decoder, char buffer, BOM detection and decoder replacement semantics. Merely disabling FileStream buffering would expose 1 KiB underlying reads; the pooled wrapper retains logical 4 KiB read-ahead.
options_preserved: synchronous reads and existing200ms IOException retry
no metadata/hash shortcut;no custom decoder;no new dependency/reflection

production_source_binding.integration_status: Production working-tree snapshot; parent owns final checks/commit. Binding permits only the listed namespace/header/helper-delegation differences.

raw_proof.source_and_actual_runtime_manifest_refer: The allocation report contains complete before/after hashes for source/project/props/compiler references/app/actual installed runtime files; all matched.
